data_dependencies: causal Massive equity bars, NBBO, volume, same-time-of-day baselines, VWAP, opening range, and market/sector context
point-in-time tradability, security-status, halt, filing, financing, and dilution context
prospectively frozen setup transition, trigger, invalidation, chase ceiling, and outcome horizon
causal_inputs.decision_time_rule: One causal setup transition per Pilot variant and ticker-session is frozen at T before any outcome is observed.
causal_inputs.completed_bar_rule: Completed-bar setup features end at T-1; trigger crossing requires separately timestamped current price/quote evidence.
causal_inputs.missing_data_rule: Execution-critical missing data makes the research observation non-executable; contextual missingness remains UNKNOWN.

setup_rules: separate versioned challengers for opening-range acceptance, VWAP reclaim/retest, first controlled pullback, and tight-base release
one transition per setup variant and ticker-session; overlapping minute observations are not independent evidence
entry_or_research_rules: research observations only; no broker review, risk authorization, buying-power reservation, or order
freeze trigger, limit/chase ceiling, structural invalidation, quote, spread, maximum wait, and cancel conditions at T
exit_or_outcome_rules: UNKNOWN until each challenger has one frozen cost-adjusted exit policy and first-passage target/stop/timeout semantics
same-bar trigger, confirmation, fill, target, and stop ambiguity must fail closed or use event-sequenced quote/tick evidence
invalidations: support, VWAP, opening-range, or base acceptance failure; stale/crossed quote; failed liquidity; extension/exhaustion; adverse security evidence
any attempted LIVE, PAPER, broker, risk, or allocation action under this SHADOW-only contract

notes: Each challenger must preserve causal decision timestamps and be graded separately from the incumbent.

lane_risk_translation.notional_rule: UNKNOWN; no quantity, buying power, or capital is authorized or reserved.
lane_risk_translation.stop_defined_risk_rule: Research R is anchored to the frozen executable fill and structural invalidation, never the prior-bar observation close.
lane_risk_translation.stress_loss_rule: Must include decision-time spread, slippage, gap-through, halt, liquidity, and correlation stress before any promotion claim.
lane_adjustments: above-$5 and $1-$5 equities are separate evidence lanes
opening 25-minute and later-session transitions are separate time regimes
ORB, VWAP reclaim, first pullback, and tight base remain separate challenger identities or subcontracts in analysis

cost_execution_model.quote_source: Requires decision-time executable bid/ask and size; stale backfilled spreads are not admissible.
cost_execution_model.spread_model: Use causal half-spread or validated fill shortfall on both entry and exit and report quote coverage/age.
cost_execution_model.slippage_model: Must include next-event confirmation-safe fill, stop slippage, gap-through, and halt resumption.
cost_execution_model.fee_model: Report applicable fees and do not silently assume unavailable costs are zero.
cost_execution_model.fill_model: No same-bar full-volume confirmation and fill; use next executable event/bar unless event sequence proves ordering.
cost_execution_model.maximum_contractual_loss_rule: Long equity has no contractual stop guarantee; report stress and gap loss separately.

session_calendar_rules.calendar: U.S. equity trading calendar with premarket, regular-session, halt, and early-close handling
session_calendar_rules.research_or_entry_window: SHADOW observations by declared premarket, opening-25-minute, and later-session regimes; no active broker entry window.
session_calendar_rules.mandatory_flat_rule: All modeled challenger outcomes end under a predeclared intraday horizon; no overnight transfer.
session_calendar_rules.holiday_rule: No equity-session observation on a verified market holiday.

entry_or_research_kill_conditions: decision-time quote or event ordering unavailable for an executability claim
future leakage, outcome-enriched cohort contamination, or overlapping-observation pseudo-replication detected
cost, gap-through, or halt stress missing from a profitability result
any non-SHADOW book mode or nonzero trade, risk, reservation, or allocation authority
suspension_criteria.operator_stop_semantics: Registered SHADOW research is zero-authority; it cannot alter, release, or bypass the LIVE emergency-entry stop.

known_failure_modes: multiple setup labels on one move can overstate independent evidence
opening volatility can make modeled fills unrealistic
parameter search can overfit a small number of ticker sessions
ranking improvements may identify volatility rather than directional edge
